Packs.AncestryFeatures: Tech Core: Companion Support & Advanced Maneuvers

RobotCompanion.Description:
The base robot companion before chassis selection. It has the construct, robot, and tech traits; it is neither a living creature nor undead.

Pending chassis selection: size, Speeds, attribute modifiers (Str, Dex, Con, Int, Wis, Cha), base attacks, ancestry Hit Points (4 to 10), trained skills, Support Benefit, and Advanced Maneuver.

Senses: precise vision, imprecise hearing, and vague touch. It has no sense of smell or taste. Chassis or customizations may grant additional vision types.

Commercial customizations are determined by the Robot Companion or Drone Companion class.

DroneCompanion.Description:
The base form of a Mechanic's Drone Exocortex, prior to selecting a chassis, commercial customizations, or advancement options. A drone companion is a construct, robot, and tech (replacing the animal trait); it is neither living nor undead.

Size, Speeds, Attribute Modifiers, Hit Points, Trained Skills, Base Attacks, Support Benefit, Advanced Maneuver: pending chassis selection.

Senses: precise vision, imprecise hearing, vague touch; no smell or taste.

RobotCompanionTraits.Description:
Command: Spending 1 action to Command your robot companion grants it 2 actions during your turn. It follows the standard companion movement, positioning, and command rules.

Attacks: Its proficiency rank with simple and martial weapons equals its proficiency rank in unarmed attacks. It requires the Integrated Weapon Mount or Manual Dexterity customization to wield weapons.

Immunities: bleed, death effects, disease, doomed, drained, fatigued, healing, mental, nonlethal attacks, paralyzed, poison, sickened, spirit, unconscious, vitality, and void. Weakness: electricity equal to half its level, rounded up. It does not eat, breathe, or sleep.

Repair and broken: It cannot be healed by effects that restore Hit Points to living creatures; restoring Hit Points requires the Repair action or another object-repairing ability. At 0 Hit Points it becomes broken instead of being destroyed. Administer First Aid can stabilize it using Crafting instead of Medicine. It does not gain or track the wounded condition. If it becomes broken more than twice within 10 minutes, it is destroyed and requires 1 day of downtime to reconstruct.

Companion DC: equal to your class DC. Class selection determines commercial customizations and any class-specific control or repair features.

DroneCompanionTraits.Description:
Your Mechanic's exocortex program is immune to the glitching condition, but the linked Drone Companion is not.

Senses

Precise vision; imprecise hearing; vague touch. A drone companion has no sense of smell or taste. Darkvision or low-light vision is granted by the chassis or customizations.

Attacks

The drone's proficiency rank with simple and martial weapons equals its proficiency rank in unarmed attacks. To wield weapons it requires an Integrated Weapon Mount or Manual Dexterity customization.

Neural Command

The mechanic controls the drone with thoughts at a range of up to 150 feet. Spending 1 action to Command the drone grants it 2 actions during your turn. Only the mechanic can operate, control, and Repair their drone. If the drone is beyond 150 feet of the mechanic, it cannot perform any actions.

Immunities and Weakness

Immune to bleed, death effects, disease, doomed, drained, fatigued, healing, mental, nonlethal attacks, paralyzed, poison, sickened, spirit, unconscious, vitality, and void. Weakness to electricity equal to half its level (rounded up). The drone does not eat, breathe, or sleep.

Repair and Broken

The drone cannot be healed by effects that restore Hit Points to living creatures. Restoring Hit Points requires the Repair action or other object-repairing abilities. It is automatically repaired to full Hit Points during daily preparations, and can be restored to maximum Hit Points by spending 1 hour to Repair (10 minutes with Quick Repair).

Reaching 0 Hit Points causes the drone to become broken rather than destroyed. It can be stabilized with Administer First Aid using Crafting instead of Medicine. It does not gain or track the wounded condition. If it becomes broken more than twice within a 10-minute period, it is destroyed and requires 1 day of downtime to reconstruct.

Companion DC and Customizations

The companion DC equals the mechanic's class DC. The drone gains 1 base Commercial Customization available to all robot companions plus 2 from the Drone Exocortex feature (3 total before feats or advancement). Commercial Customizations are treated as ancestry feats on the actor sheet.
